authority.warning: This graph records audit findings and recommendations; it does not authorize implementation.

approvalOverlay.firstSlice: owned-hardware finder -> configuration portfolio -> exact detail -> separately gated runner handoff and verification
deferredModules: M-K private Arena until after first slice
approvalOverlay.warning: The M-A status below still means no production shared-contract package exists; documentation schema v1 is frozen for its future checkpoint.

modules.name: shared-contracts
currentConsumers: all current domain modules and surfaces
modules.finding: C1-C12 are fragmented and cross-language equivalents are not versioned together.

modules.name: llmfit-core-adapter
modules.finding: No production code references llmfit; the adoption audit is a proposal.
evidence: rg -i llmfit app lib runner scripts tests returned no matches

modules.name: model-artifact-registry
modules.finding: Strong deterministic registry core exists, but consumers import generated records or embedded data without a frozen M-C interface.

modules.name: hardware-inventory
modules.finding: Exact registry and Windows detection are reusable; website and runner surfaces bypass an orchestrator, and non-Windows GPU detection is absent.

modules.name: runtime-compatibility
modules.finding: Runtime/build compatibility is tested, but candidate construction is owned by recommendation and serving-config import is absent.

modules.name: fit-performance-estimator
modules.finding: Pure fail-closed fit and scoped throughput envelopes pass; llmfit equivalence and adapter separation are unresolved.

modules.name: evidence-normalization
modules.finding: Evidence scope and claim honesty are strong; local fit-profile schema and draft vocabulary need unification.

modules.name: safe-recommendation
modules.finding: Fail-closed recommendation is tested, but it also owns candidate assembly and presentation, and surfaces call it directly.

modules.name: local-model-inventory
modules.finding: Read-only consent-gated scan is reusable; hash upgrade and orchestrated interface are missing.

modules.name: benchmark-verification
modules.finding: Existing-engine exact observations are reusable; bundled engine, T7 sandbox, GPU/thermal telemetry, artifact binding and calibration transfer are absent.

modules.name: solo-arena
modules.finding: Only fixed mechanical checks exist; there is no general execution plan/result, private comparison flow, history or result provenance contract.

modules.name: public-pair-contribution
currentConsumers: M-M precursor could consume validated records only after M-L exists
modules.finding: No pair generator, consent/review payload, upload, revocation or abuse boundary exists.

modules.name: aggregation-rating
modules.finding: Validated bucketed ratings pass and stay dark; there is no approved M-L producer or public consumer.

modules.name: public-evidence-service
modules.finding: No service/API/storage implementation exists; draft endpoints are not authorized.

modules.name: application-orchestrator
currentConsumers: M-P should be its only surface consumer
modules.finding: No orchestrator exists; direct imports/invokes are the primary current architecture violation.

modules.name: surface-adapters
modules.finding: Accessible honest behaviors exist, but current shells bypass M-O and screen contracts are not frozen.

currentViolations.recommendedResolution: route through M-O after C-contract freeze
expose application use cases through M-O
move assembly to adapters/orchestrator and pass complete candidates to M-H
